# Learn Core Skills

> Free, mastery-based practice activities for children across mathematics and the whole-child skills framework, tracked per child, with no lesson videos to sit through. Works in English and French; progress data stays on the family's device.

## Main pages

- [Home (English)](https://learncoreskills.com/en): what the product is and how to start
- [Accueil (français)](https://learncoreskills.com/fr): présentation du produit en français
- [Mathematics](https://learncoreskills.com/en/mathematics): grade-by-grade mathematics syllabus and practice activities
- [Parent area](https://learncoreskills.com/en/parent): follow your child's mastery progress, export or import their data

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://learncoreskills.com/en/docs): specifications and reference documents behind the product
- [Blog](https://learncoreskills.com/en/blog): the story of the project, one post per shipped feature
